sourceFile: 07. MSU-20S15-07 Report TEST use IR Dry machine test for SUB1 2025.01.22_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft cites real rows but misstates the changed factor and omits the tension outcome.
issues: Changed factor should be IR dry TEST 30s/1min at 120do vs Normal dry box 5min at 120do, not just Normal vs TEST.
Two TEST time conditions are distinct subgroups and should not be collapsed without labeling.
Tension test rows are part of the same validation report but are omitted as outcomes.
Evidence set omits key header rows defining Time dry and Temp for both sections.
Subgroup key incorrectly uses only the Normal dry box condition.
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor to dry method/time condition comparison.
Model TEST 30s and TEST 1min as separate subresults against Normal dry box 5min.
Add tension outcome using MIN, MAX, AVG and sample values from rows 7-9.
Add header evidence rows Sheet1!6, Sheet1!12, and Sheet1!13.
Revise subgroup keys to include date, type, time dry, temp, and section context.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but header and condition-defining citations are incomplete.
